title: Beheaded
description: Craft player heads and rename them in an anvil to choose any skin you want.
body:
Beheaded allows you to craft player heads and change their skin by renaming them in an anvil.

This makes it easy to create custom decorative heads without needing commands or external tools.

Features:

  • Craftable player heads
  • Rename heads in an anvil to change their skin
  • Simple way to create decorative or collectible heads
